title: Generate a KiCad schematic

images.alt: KiCad schematic generated from a TypeScript circuit definition
images.caption: Define components and connect their pins in TypeScript. The framework turns those connections into a native KiCad schematic, shown here with routed wires.

description: Define components and connect their pins in TypeScript. The framework turns those connections into a native KiCad schematic, shown here with routed wires.
